readmeExcerpt:
AI is in your development workflow. While the token spend shows it, the throughput doesn't. The human is very much still in the loop, and that's a context problem. Join live (FREE) on Aug 19 to see why teams get stuck and how leading teams use a context engine to fix it. (Thanks to Unblocked for sponsoring this page.)

recentPulls.author: WBHankins93

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive open-source curriculum for mastering scalable system design.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: System Design Academy provides a structured, deep-dive curriculum designed to help engineers understand and architect large-scale distributed systems. The repository compiles meticulously detailed articles, architectural diagrams, and case studies of real-world systems like Netflix and Twitter. It breaks down complex topics such as load balancing, database sharding, caching strategies, and microservices architecture into digestible lessons. This resource is tailored not just for interview preparation, but for practical application in everyday software engineering. It provides practical insights and architectural patterns to help software professionals advance their technical capabilities in AI engineering.
keyFeatures: Structured Curriculum: Follows a logical progression from basic networking concepts to complex distributed architectures.
Real-World Case Studies: Analyzes the architecture of industry giants to understand their design decisions and trade-offs.
Interactive Diagrams: Includes visual aids that help clarify data flow and component interactions.
Community Contributions: Constantly updated by experienced engineers to reflect modern architectural patterns.
Interview Preparation Guide: Dedicated sections focusing on common system design interview questions and frameworks.
Structured Curriculums: Organizes system design topics systematically to facilitate deeper technical learning.

useCases.title: Software Engineers
useCases.description: Learn the principles of distributed systems to design more scalable and resilient applications.

useCases.title: Interview Candidates
useCases.description: Prepare comprehensively for system design rounds at top-tier technology companies.

useCases.title: Engineering Managers
useCases.description: Use the materials to train and upskill team members on architectural best practices.

useCases.title: Students
useCases.description: Bridge the gap between academic computer science theory and practical industry applications.

useCases.title: Interview Preparation
useCases.description: Candidates study real-world architectural scenarios to prepare for complex AI engineering technical interviews.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This academy is designed for software engineers ranging from mid-level looking to advance to senior roles, to anyone preparing for technical interviews. A foundational understanding of programming and basic web architecture is recommended.
